title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: This release fixes two defects in the duplicate name handling added in 1.42.328: Remove Test Only Code could delete the tests of a live enum entry sharing its name with a dead one, and removing a declaration that shares its name with one in another package could leave its import behind when that import line ended with a comment.

highlights.title: Tests of live enum entries kept
highlights.description: Remove Test Only Code no longer deletes a test of a live enum entry because a dead entry of another enum has the same name.

highlights.title: Commented imports removed
highlights.description: Removing a declaration whose name also exists in another package now removes its import even when the import line ends with a comment, so the file still compiles.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed Remove Test Only Code deleting a test of a live enum entry. When MediaSource.FEED was used only by tests while EventSource.FEED was used in the app, a test that imported EventSource.FEED and wrote only FEED was planned for removal with MediaSource.FEED. The removal is now withheld whenever a test may name the other entry.

Fixed the removal of a declaration sharing its name with one in another package leaving its import behind when the line read import p.Name followed by a comment. The file no longer compiled once the declaration was gone.
